title: Mushroom & Ricotta Ravioli
subtitle: with Rana Pasta & Charred Zucchini
description: Indulge in pure trattoria-style luxury with Rana's fresh mushroom ravioli, brimming with a rich, earthy filling that delivers restaurant-quality decadence straight to your plate. Gently tossed with smokey charred zucchini, tender baby spinach and dollops of velvety ricotta, it's a luscious, ready-made dinner that punches well above its weight.

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced.
• Boil the kettle.
• Thinly slice zucchini into rounds.
• Place zucchini on a lined tray. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and toss to coat. Bake until tender, 20-25 minutes.

• Meanwhile, finely chop garlic.
• Zest lemon to get a pinch, then slice into wedges.

• When the zucchini has 5 minutes remaining, half-fill a large saucepan with boiling water and add a generous pinch of salt.
• Cook Rana mushroom ravioli over high heat until ‘al dente’, 3 minutes.
• Reserve some pasta water (see ingredients). Drain ravioli and return to the saucepan.
• TIP: Fresh pasta moves quickly! 3 minutes is all it needs to hit that perfect ‘al dente’ bite.
• TIP: The pasta will naturally separate as it cooks!

• Meanwhile, heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
• Cook garlic and herb & mushroom seasoning until fragrant, 1 minute.
• Add light cooking cream, lemon zest and the reserved pasta water and simmer until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Remove frying pan from the heat, then stir through charred zucchini, baby spinach leaves, a generous squeeze of lemon juice and cooked ravioli. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

• Divide mushroom ravioli and charred zucchini between bowls.
• Top with small spoonfuls of ricotta and serve with any remaining lemon wedges. Enjoy!
